selection_basis: The two Sequencing applicability tasks fixed in the original roles.json, ordered by the public input size: seven clips before thirteen. No score-based selection or replacement.
prerequisites: finish the frozen Assembly Task14 pair
zero-model verification that each task uses complete clips and the current manifest interface
verify official material hashes and freeze identical input/image/tool configuration before each pair
library_revision_policy: Reuse the exact already-frozen Task14 library and runtime; no learning, recertification, interface edits or oracle-based binding from these successor tasks. Baseline uses the same owner's empty store.
quality: Unchanged official Sequencing video verifier; report raw aggregate quality separately from normalized reward, actual C adoption and local manifest correctness.
shared_policy: Identical existing trial.py, native tools, current video metadata, labelled temporal evidence policy and Artifact value-input flag on both sides. Only the capability catalog differs.
adoption: Optional; no forced C use or supplied clip order. Keep failures, refusals, unknown usage, retries and recovery in the original cumulative ledger.
expansion: Only these two previously planned applicability tasks. Do not expand Repair/Repurpose or use these tasks to repair the learned program. Incompatible input is an applicability/fallback result.
